title: Presented at FSNNA '26 & Featured at Oracle AI World 2026
content:
Presented my co-authored paper *'Finders, Keepers, Viewers, Readers'* at the Fan Studies Network North America (FSNNA) Conference—quantifying how 63 book-to-screen adaptations trigger a 115.7x median surge across 407,449 AO3 fanworks and up to +3.97-bit Shannon entropy in *Bridgerton* and *Heated Rivalry*. [View Poster DOI](https://doi.org/10.13140/RG.2.2.33712.52481)

Also saw our agentic Engineering Change Orders app with **Oracle FusionClaw** autonomous workflows featured at **Oracle AI World 2026**!

title: Joined GoSaaS & Earned Oracle Fusion AI Certification
content: Started as an Associate Software Engineer at **GoSaaS, Inc.** in September, architecting and hardening enterprise AI agents across core Oracle Fusion modules using Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio, MCP servers, and RAG pipelines—and earned my **Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio Certified Developer Professional (Rel 26-2)** certification!

title: Wrapping Up Developer Advocacy at Educative
content: Wrapped up an unforgettable chapter as Developer Advocate at Educative: scaled technical content to **3.4M+ LinkedIn impressions**, hosted 8 webinars reaching 17,000+ developers, co-led the **30 Days of Code** campaign (~7,000 new users, 595% traffic surge, 1.5M+ email opens), and lifted Trustpilot from 2.5 to 4.1 stars.

title: Paper Published in Digital Studies / Le champ numérique
content: After a year of work, my paper *'Hooked on a Feeling: A Computational Approach Towards Understanding Songwriting as Cultural Memory'* (N = 353 Grammy nominees, DistilBERT + TF-IDF) has been published in **Digital Studies / Le champ numérique, 16(1)**. [Read it here](https://doi.org/10.16995/dscn.23539)

title: Guardian Angel Preprint Published on arXiv
content: Our senior capstone paper *'LLM-Enhanced Wearables for Comprehensible Health Guidance in LMICs'* ($12.72 screenless wristband, 67% HR MAE reduction, 96h 20-user field study) is live on arXiv. [Read arXiv:2602.08701](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08701)
